title: Bronchoscopy
description: A bronchoscopy allows your doctor to visualize your airways using a thin, flexible camera to diagnose or treat lung problems. Your pulmonologist passes the bronchoscope through your mouth or nose into your lungs. The procedure typically takes 15-45 minutes under light sedation. This category includes diagnostic scopes to visualize airways, diagnostic with biopsy to collect tissue samples, and therapeutic procedures using lasers, stents, or heat treatment. You go home the same day after recovery from sedation. Your throat may feel sore temporarily. The cost of this procedure may vary depending on the complexity involved. Categories include diagnostic, diagnostic, with biopsy, therapeutic, simple, therapeutic with ebus-guidance, and therapeutic with bronchial thermoplasty.
